text:
Nora C: heads-up from AE: customer wants a 'flex-credits escrow' model for pilot — upfront pool that releases weekly, rollover allowed up to a cap, with explicit SLA credits if we breach latency. they want quick switch to dedicated on 48h notice.

Felix D: notable asks = escrow + rollover + auto-upgrade window. pricing-wise escrow behaves like committed credits but with a smaller margin. i'll need expected burn rate to model.

Omar S: infra: auto-upgrade is non-trivial. we can offer a fast-path but requires pre-warmed fleet and agreed capacity reservation. ops cost = reserved-hours * instance-rate. we should require signed ops playbook and notice window.

Priya V: legal note: escrow with SLA-credit for latency breaches = tricky. propose: SLA credit pool that offsets next invoice up to X% and explicit conditions for triggering. no open-ended rollback.

Felix D: sketch of commercial options:
```
Option A: Pilot Escrow Basic
- upfront credits: negotiated
- rollover: up to 25% max
- upgrade: manual request, 72h SLA
- price uplift: +10% for priority routing

Option B: Pilot Escrow Fast-Path
- upfront credits + reserved warm capacity
- rollover: up to 10%
- upgrade: 48h automated (if pre-approved capacity)
- price uplift: +20% and non-refundable warm-hours
```

Nora C: AE wants the contract clause language for upgrade path and escrow release schedule. can legal + finance draft an exhibit?

Priya V: i'll write a short exhibit template: triggers, credit release cadence, SLA credit math, and an audit window. will post a first draft in #legal by EOD.

billing-bot: note: to support rollover we need a billing flag and a remaining-credits webhook. tagging @engineering-billing for API changes.

Omar S: ops question: how do we measure SLA latency for this? suggest tenant-level p95 tail and a separate priority routing metric. also need alerts when escrow burn rate will deplete within 48h.

Nora C: go/no-go checklist draft: 1) pricing option agreed (Felix) 2) legal exhibit (Priya) 3) ops pre-warm runbook + feature-flag (Omar) 4) billing webhook + UI display (billing) 5) AE term sheet and customer sign-off.

Felix D: i'll run three burn scenarios (50%/100%/200% of expected) and post numbers.

audit-bot: auto: created ticket FIN-4321 for escrow billing flow. assigned to Felix D & engineering-billing.

Nora C: thanks all. please update this thread with drafts. aiming for decision in next Tuesday sync. :thumbsup:
